shots.text: Dirt. That's the first thing I felt.
shots.note: Macro on dirt grains. Rack focus pulls through the out-of-focus grains to reveal 250's head lying in the dirt, eyes closed.

shots.text: Cold dirt on my face, and a heartbeat that wasn't slowing down.
shots.note: Extreme close-up of 250's head on the dirt. Heartbeat pulses through the frame; his eye slowly opens.

shots.text: They told me later I was gone for two days.
shots.note: Wide: 250 lying still on the chamber floor while sisters walk past without stopping. The light rises and falls (time passing).
Cold, desaturated close shot of his motionless body. Dust settles on him.
His eye snaps open with a green glint; sound waves ripple out. Hyper senses begin (slow motion).

shots.text: a beetle digging three tunnels over,
shots.note: X-ray through the dirt: a beetle glowing as an outline, digging three tunnels away.

shots.text: a drop of water about to fall.
shots.note: Slow motion: a drop swelling on a root tip, trembling, about to fall.
250 pushes himself up off the dirt; his long mandibles cock open. Rim-lit hero shot.
Among his sisters he looks identical. Only a tiny green glint gives him away.

shots.text: And before this... I was nobody.
shots.note: Pull back: the tunnels go on forever. 250 is a speck in the middle of it all.
